Retrieve Institutional costs Claims

Source: R/get_IN_REV_costs.R
get_IN_REV_costs.Rd

Searches institutional claim files for costs for specified USRDS_IDs in specified years. Handles CSV, SAS, and Parquet formats.

Usage

get_IN_REV_costs(years, usrds_ids = NULL, drop_total_lines = TRUE)

Arguments

years

Integer vector of years to include.

usrds_ids

Optional vector of USRDS_IDs to filter to specific patients.

drop_total_lines

If TRUE (the default), drop lines with revenue center code 0001. The 2025 Researcher's Guide (Section 5, "Institutional Claims Details and Revenue Center Details") reports that the 0001 line's REV_CH is the sum of the claim's other lines' REV_CH, so keeping it counts the charges twice. The Guide does not describe REVPMT on that line; dropping the line removes its REVPMT too. Lines whose code is missing are kept. In files that have CDTYPE (det files before 2008, which also hold diagnosis and procedure lines), only revenue center lines (CDTYPE "R") are dropped or have their codes padded; the other lines, including those with a missing or blank CDTYPE, are returned unchanged for now.

Value

A data frame with one row per revenue center line and columns USRDS_ID, CLM_FROM and CLM_THRU (claim from and through dates), REV_DT (revenue center date), CODE (revenue center code, as text with its leading zeros), REV_CH (revenue center total charge), REVPMT (revenue center payment amount) and HCFASAF (claim type, as a factor). Dates are of class Date. Descriptions are from Appendix B of the 2025 Researcher's Guide (for example table OP_DET_2023). A column a file does not have is NA for that file's lines. Dates stored as text that cannot be read become NA, with a warning naming the file and column.

With CLM_FROM and CLM_THRU, the result can go straight into prorate_costs_by_day(). Do not add these amounts to claim totals from get_IN_CLM_costs() for the same claims.

Details

If usrds_ids is NULL, all claims are returned.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_IN_REV_costs(years = 2012:2016, usrds_ids=1:1000)
} # }
